what: The photo row flows endlessly to the left (.075rem per frame). When the mouse is over the row, the offset e from the center (−1 to 1) cubed × .5 rem becomes the target speed: it stops at the center, speeds up toward the edges in that direction, and flows backward on the left side. The current speed closes 1/10 of the gap to the target each frame, and after the pointer leaves, it returns to .075rem in the last direction. With a finger, dragging horizontally follows at .1rem per 1px, and on release it keeps flowing at the last step distance ÷ 8.5 as speed, then settles (a vertical swipe scrolls the page)

options.base: Resting speed (rem/frame), default .075 — after leaving the row, it continues at this speed in the last direction
options.gain: Top speed at the end (rem/frame), default .5 — target = gain × e × |e|²
options.lerp: Portion approached toward the target each frame, default .1
options.drag: rem moved per 1px when dragging, default .1
options.fling: Release speed = Last step (px) ÷ fling, default 8.5
options.--fx-gap: Gap between photos and between sets (css variable), default 20px
options.[data-fx-part=set]: One set inside the band (photo group) — clone two more sets and join them end to end

from.where: shared.js .nl-gallery (scene photo row) · .nl-related (related brands row in the footer) — original gallery: d += (u − d)/10, u = .5·e·|e|², ±.075 on leaving, rewind every set width + 20px (phone 10px), phone drag (x − x0)/−10 rem · on release (start x − end x)/8.5
shared.js .nl-related (footer related brand logo row — based on window width)

shared.js SL.flow — footer related brand logo strip · a thumbnail strip for each gallery section (original gallery__pager: rest .05rem/frame, target .3·e·|e|², follows by 1/10 each step, phone drag 1px = .1rem · on release, last step ÷ 8.5)

index.js .ix-insta (social photo strip — original index__instagram: rest .06rem per frame, target .75·e·|e|², listens only over the strip, e is based on window width, follows at 1/10 per step, phone drag 1px = .1rem · on release, last step ÷ 8.5)

shared.js .nl-foot__related (footer affiliate logo band)·lookbook.js .lb-pager (thumbnail band per category — e is based on slide width) — original footer__main__related·gallery__pager: rest .05rem/frame, target .3·e·|e|²

note: The original uses a fixed step per frame — the part treats 60fps as one frame and scales by the time between frames, so the speed is the same on 120Hz screens. Dragging accepts horizontal movement only via touch-action: pan-y and does not block touch (preventDefault). It pauses when off screen.
